title.zh: 查一个词，顺手读到它的来龙去脉
title.en: Look up a word, stay for the context

lead.zh: 术语、体裁、乐器名、作品编号与中国音乐，一条先说清，再链到能深读的条目。可以按读谱、按体裁、按外文名或按编号进入。
lead.en: Terms, genres, instrument names, work numbers and Chinese music: defined in a sentence, then linked to deeper reading. Enter by notation, genre, foreign name or catalogue number.

needs_title.en: Where did you meet the word

needs_sub.zh: 同一个词在不同场景里的重点不同，先选场景再看释义。
needs_sub.en: The same term matters differently by context; pick the context first.

d.zh: 力度、速度、奏法与反复记号，先分清它管哪一层。
d.en: Dynamics, tempo, technique and repeats: know which layer the mark controls.

d.zh: 看编制、场合与长度，比看名字可靠。
d.en: Forces, setting and length are more reliable than the name.

d.zh: 同一个乐器在不同语言里有不同名字，按音译与实物对照。
d.en: One instrument, many names; match transliteration with the actual object.

d.zh: BWV、S.、TWV 与 Anh. 各管一个作曲家或一类附录，不是年代。
d.en: BWV, S., TWV and Anh. belong to composers or appendices, not to chronology.

d.zh: 燕乐、清乐、曲牌与调门，背后是调式与场合的整套约定。
d.en: Yanyue, qingyue, qupai and diaomen encode a whole system of modes and occasions.

d.zh: 版税、机械复制权与母带权，先弄清收的是哪一层钱。
d.en: Royalty, mechanical licence and master rights: know which layer of money is being collected.

ladder_sub.zh: 从一句话定义到深读，别停在第一句。
ladder_sub.en: From the one-line definition to deeper reading; do not stop at the first sentence.

d.zh: 能一句话说清，说明这个概念有边界。
d.en: If it fits in a sentence, it has an edge.

d.zh: 别名常常暴露它的来源与误用。
d.en: Aliases often reveal origin and misuse.

d.zh: 一个词周围的词，才是它真正的语境。
d.en: The words around it are its real context.

d.zh: 词典负责定位，理论和历史负责展开。
d.en: The glossary locates; theory and history expand.

picks_sub.zh: 覆盖读谱、体裁、编号、制作、版权与中国音乐。
picks_sub.en: Covering notation, genre, numbering, production, rights and Chinese music.

why.zh: 一个体裁的名字，背后是编制与场合的整套约定。
why.en: A genre name that encodes forces and setting.

why.zh: 编号不是年代，先弄清它属于谁。
why.en: A catalogue number is not a date; know whose catalogue it is.

why.zh: 曲牌是旋律骨架，也是填词与场合的单位。
why.en: Qupai is a melodic skeleton and a unit of text-setting and occasion.

why.zh: 制作术语里最常被误解的一个。
why.en: One of the most misunderstood production terms.

why.zh: 公版不是“随便用”，要看地区与版本。
why.en: Public domain is not a free-for-all; region and edition matter.

why.zh: 一件乐器如何被名字、形制与演奏法共同定义。
why.en: How name, shape and technique define an instrument together.

trails_title.en: Three routes from word to thing

trails_sub.zh: 把词条当入口，顺着读到具体做法与历史。
trails_sub.en: Use the entry as a door, then read into practice and history.

d.zh: 力度、记号、指法谱与双音。
d.en: Dynamics, signs, tablature and double stops.

d.zh: BWV、S.、TWV 与 Anh. 的分工。
d.en: What BWV, S., TWV and Anh. each cover.

d.zh: 从燕乐到曲牌，再到三分损益。
d.en: From yanyue to qupai and sanfen sunyi.
